rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for comfort or solace given to someone.

example.english: Your words of consolation made me feel better.
example.traditional: 你句安慰令我個心舒服咗。
example.jyutping: nei5 geoi3 on1 wai3 ling6 ngo5 go3 sam1 syu1 fuk6 zo2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a prize or benefit given to someone who loses.

example.english: Although I lost, I still got a consolation prize.
example.traditional: 雖然我輸咗，但都有個安慰獎。
example.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 syu1 zo2 daan6 dou1 jau5 go3 on1 wai3 zoeng2
